html:
G'oya

Har bir reysni (from_city, to_city) juftligi deb qarang. Teskari yo'nalish bor-yo'qligini bilish uchun jadvalni ikkinchi marta, ustunlarini almashtirib olamiz: (to_city, from_city). Ikki ro'yxatda ham bor juftlik ikki tomonlama yo'nalish bo'ladi. Bu kesishma, INTERSECT.

Yechim

SELECT from_city AS city_a, to_city AS city_b
FROM flights WHERE from_city < to_city
INTERSECT
SELECT to_city, from_city
FROM flights WHERE to_city < from_city

Birinchi qism alifbo tartibida yozilgan reyslarni oladi (Samarqand -> Toshkent), ikkinchisi teskari yozilganlarini, lekin ustunlarni almashtirib (Toshkent -> Samarqand ham ('Samarqand', 'Toshkent') bo'ladi). Ikkalasida ham bor juftlik ikki tomonlama. Takroriy reyslarni INTERSECT o'zi olib tashlaydi.

Tuzoqlar

city_a < city_b shartisiz har bir juftlik ikki marta chiqadi: ('Samarqand', 'Toshkent') va ('Toshkent', 'Samarqand').

Shartni ikkala qismga bir xil yozish ham xato. Ikkinchi qism ustunlar almashgani uchun teskari tartibdagi juftliklarni beradi, kesishma doim bo'sh qoladi:

Noto'g'riSELECT from_city, to_city FROM flights WHERE from_city < to_city
INTERSECT
SELECT to_city, from_city FROM flights WHERE from_city < to_city

Shartni butun natijaga qo'llash kerak bo'lsa, INTERSECTni hosila jadvalga o'rab, tashqarida WHERE city_a < city_b yozing.

JOIN bilan yozilganda Toshkent va Samarqand orasidagi har bir juft reys alohida qator beradi. Namunada Toshkentdan Samarqandga ikki reys bor, shuning uchun DISTINCT kerak.

Boshqa yo'l

SELECT DISTINCT f1.from_city AS city_a, f1.to_city AS city_b
FROM flights f1
JOIN flights f2 ON f2.from_city = f1.to_city AND f2.to_city = f1.from_city
WHERE f1.from_city < f1.to_city
